  <header class="portfolio-group__header"><h2>Systems reliability and failure evidence</h2><p>Research infrastructure for reproducing low-level failures while preserving exact identity, provenance, and independently checkable evidence.</p></header>

      <p class="portfolio-proof"><strong>Evidence surfaced</strong> Canonical Case IR, seeded scheduling, an append-only SQLite journal, exact signatures, 3/3 simulated replay, recorded G3, E1, E2, and minimization artifacts, semantic verification, and multi-platform CI.</p>
